Maya: Quick heads-up — scheduling a reserved-capacity rollout for AcmeCorp (Dedicated) tonight 22:00 PT. Goal: move traffic to reserved pool, validate failover, and confirm version pin before final cutover. @Sam @Liam @Anika can you ack the failover playbook?
DeployBot: [deploybot] New rollout created: acmecorp-dedicated-v2 -> scheduled 2026-03-21T22:00:00-07:00. Canary plan: 5% -> 25% -> 100% over 30m. Preflight hooks queued. Run ID: db-roll-1761123450.
Sam: Thanks — can you paste the quick TL;DR for the failover steps here? want to confirm RPO/RTO and where traffic shifts happen.
Liam: TL;DR from the playbook: 1) Drain old slice, 2) activate reserved pool, 3) run health-checks on all endpoints, 4) fail traffic back to fallback pool if >1% errors for 5m, 5) kms key watch during final commit. Link: https://intranet.redwood/playbooks/acmecorp-failover (short).
Anika: What are the rollback triggers for this rollout? we had false positives on metric jitter last time. need a clear metric set.
Maya: Rollback triggers: a) 99th latency increase >150ms over baseline for 3 consecutive 1m buckets, b) error rate >1% sustained for 5m, c) model mismatch score regression >2% on golden prompts. If any trigger fires, canary halts and traffic shifts to previous dedicated pool automatically.
Jordan: KMS note — there's a scheduled rotation tomorrow morning for tenant keys. Confirming no overlap with tonight's final commit. who owns the KMS hold?
Liam: Ops owns the hold. Jordan can you cross-check rotation window? if overlap, we add a KMS hold step before final 100% commit.
Jordan: Checked — rotation is 2026-03-22T06:00:00Z, so we're clear. leaving a TODO in release notes to remove the KMS auto-rotate until 03/23 for AcmeCorp.
DeployBot: Preflight results for db-roll-1761123450: 
```
- capacity-check: OK (reserved pool 1.2x required)
- config-validate: OK
- kms-status: OK
- smoke-tests: 8/8 passed
- canary-policy: configured (5 -> 25 -> 100)
```
DeployBot: Canary dry-run (no traffic) completed — no errors. Ready for ops signoff.
Sam: I ran through the playbook quickly. ack from me pending one small change: update the emergency rollback command to include a force-drain flag. I added the snippet to the playbook.
Maya: Good catch. I updated the release notes to call out the force-drain CLI: `redwoodctl drain --slice acmecorp-old --force` and included contact points.
Anika: ACK from SRE. I’ll be watching 99th latency and error-rate dashboards against the thresholds listed. Oncall alerted.
Liam: Ops ACK. Will hold keyboard for kms hold toggle if needed.
Maya: Thanks — we have consensus. DeployBot please proceed with canary at 22:00 PT. If any rollback trigger trips, route to oncall and rollback to previous pool automatically. :thumbsup: 
DeployBot: Canary scheduled and will run at 2026-03-21T22:00:00-07:00. Notifying oncall channel.
Sam: Posting final change window in calendar + added the rollback runbook link. See you on the channel during the window.
Jordan: Leaving a quick note for post-mortem: capture observed KV cache warmup time. may affect early canary latency.
Maya: Will capture. Closing thread for preflight. Reopen if anything else pops up. :white_check_mark:
